summary: Frontend-only validation of MOOD app after EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL fork-mismatch fix. All five requested checkpoints PASSED: (1) Training-type screens (workout-type / body-parts / explosiveness-type / lazy-training-type) correctly show 'Build my own' CTA after selecting an option (NO 'Continue' wording). (2) Choose Intensity modal opens cleanly with header / Easy / Moderate / Intense / Cancel / Generate Workouts and shows NO 'X of 3 generations remaining' and NO 'Skipping a workout uses 1 generation' text (regex scan returned 0 matches for all variants). (3) Generated cart screen bottom bar shows only Save / Start / Skip — regex /Workout\s+\d+\s+of\s+\d+/i returned null; tapping Skip 6 consecutive times cycled workouts (title changed each time: Grind & Go -> Engine Room -> ...) with NO 'No More Workouts' or 'No Generations Left' alert. (4) Home screen renders premium per-mood gradients (verified visually for Sweat/Muscle/Build explosion/Lazy/Calisthenics/Outside), wearables snapshot row is compact (CALORIES / STEPS / RESTING HR / SLEEP in one strip), no thin yellow divider line above WORKOUTS/MINUTES/STREAK stats, Featured Workouts pulled up directly below stats. (5) Guest 'Build for me' opens GuestPromptModal ('Create an Account' / 'Sign up to use Build for Me' / Create Account / I already have an account / Continue browsing as guest) — guests are correctly blocked. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (still imported in app/index.tsx, app/create-post.tsx, components/ExerciseLookupSheet.tsx, components/SmartVideoPlayer.tsx) — non-blocking, partial migration already underway per inline source comments.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package still imported in app/index.tsx:19, app/create-post.tsx:25, components/ExerciseLookupSheet.tsx:17 and components/SmartVideoPlayer.tsx:39 (Audio). Migrate Video imports to expo-video and Audio.setAudioModeAsync to expo-audio. Non-blocking for current bundle but emits deprecation warnings and will break on future Expo SDK upgrade.

action_items: Plan migration of remaining expo-av call sites (app/index.tsx, app/create-post.tsx, ExerciseLookupSheet.tsx, SmartVideoPlayer audio path) to expo-video + expo-audio to remove deprecation warnings. Not blocking this release.
critical_code_review_comments: cart.tsx is 1694 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into header, bottom-bar, exercise list, and skip/save handler modules.

IntensitySelectionModal.tsx still defines styles 'usageLimitBadge' and 'usageNote' that are no longer referenced after the generations-remaining text removal — safe to delete to avoid dead style code.

Use page.locator('text=Login').nth(1) or click coords (195, 588). rca_of_issue: No new bugs found. Previous blocker (stale EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL) is fully resolved — fresh bundle uses https://wearable-stats-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api and /api/ returns 200. All five frontend changes from the review request are live and behave as specified.
